dependency_profile: stdlib-only collector; no account or execution SDK
nautilustrader_decision: deferred; Day14 first proves the data and time semantics with public endpoints before adding an event engine
limitations: This is a local one-attempt REST smoke capture, not a 3-7 day server collector.
Lighter orderBookOrders has no exchange source timestamp in the observed response.
REST completion time is not simultaneous market time.
Contract weights and external/internal oracle states are not exposed by these book responses.
